shared_elements: carved/incised decoration covering the whole visible surface
justification: A depicts an elaborate frontal standing human figure with a towering headdress, ornaments and adjacent blocks of sign-like glyphs, while B shows only an all-over abstract field of hatched triangles and chevrons with no figures, creatures or signs at all. The only common feature is that both surfaces are densely covered with incised/carved linear decoration, a generic trait shared by countless unrelated traditions.
